raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Overview

Gemma 4 E2B/E4B build their per-layer embedding (PLE) table (`embed_tokens_per_layer`, 4.4 GiB / 5.25 GiB in bf16) outside `make_layers`, so it never reaches the weight offloader. As a result `--cpu-offload-params embed_tokens_per_layer` is silently a no-op, and plain `--cpu-offload-gb` can only offload decoder layers (slow). This PR routes the table through the UVA offloader.

## Claims

- `--cpu-offload-gb <N> --cpu-offload-params embed_tokens_per_layer` now offloads the PLE table. GPU weight memory: E2B 9.73 → 5.36 GiB, E4B 15.05 → 9.80 GiB, E4B QAT w4a16 11.02 → 5.77 GiB.
- No measurable latency cost with the table offloaded (each token gathers only its own rows over UVA): E2B 0.792 → 0.794 s, E4B QAT 0.802 → 0.801 s, E4B 1.452 → 1.451 s (512 in / 128 out, batch 1).
- Outputs are unchanged: logprobs match HF and the no-offload run for E2B and E4B.
- Side effect on plain `--cpu-offload-gb N`: the table is wrapped before the decoder layers, so it is now offloaded first. With `--cpu-offload-gb 6`: E2B 40.6 → 8.44 s, E4B QAT 11.97 → 0.799 s.
- Models without a PLE table (`hidden_size_per_layer_input == 0`, e.g. 12B, 26B-A4B) and runs without offloading are unaffected.

## Validation

All on 1x RTX 4090 (24 GB).

**Offload state** (offloaded bytes, GPU weight memory from `model_memory_usage`, whether the table is offloaded):

| Model | Flags | Before: offloaded / GPU weights / table | After: offloaded / GPU weights / table |
|---|---|---|---|
| E2B | `--cpu-offload-gb 6 --cpu-offload-params embed_tokens_per_layer` | 0 / 9.73 GiB / no | 4.38 / 5.36 GiB / yes |
| E4B | same | 0 / 15.05 GiB / no | 5.25 / 9.80 GiB / yes |
| E4B QAT w4a16 | same | 0 / 11.02 GiB / no | 5.25 / 5.77 GiB / yes |
| E2B | `--cpu-offload-gb 6` | 4.36 (decoder only) / 5.36 GiB / no | 6.01 / 3.71 GiB / yes |
| E4B QAT w4a16 | `--cpu-offload-gb 6` | 2.96 (decoder only) / 7.98 GiB / no | 6.14 / 4.86 GiB / yes |

The budget only needs to be positive when a name filter is given: with `--cpu-offload-gb 1` and `--cpu-offload-gb 5` plus `--cpu-offload-params embed_tokens_per_layer`, all three checkpoints offload exactly the whole table (4.38 / 5.25 / 5.25 GiB) and no other parameter.

**Latency** (`vllm bench latency --input-len 512 --output-len 128 --batch-size 1 --num-iters-warmup 3 --num-iters 10 --max-model-len 2048 --gpu-memory-utilization 0.85`, avg):

| Model | No offload | `--cpu-offload-gb 6 --cpu-offload-params embed_tokens_per_layer` (after) | `--cpu-offload-gb 6` before → after |
|---|---|---|---|
| E2B | 0.792 s | 0.794 s | 40.6 → 8.44 s |
| E4B QAT w4a16 | 0.802 s | 0.801 s | 11.97 → 0.799 s |
| E4B | 1.452 s | 1.451 s | not measured → 1.450 s |

`VLLM_GPU_SYNC_CHECK=error` passes with the table offloaded (E2B, batch 4: 0.514 vs 0.516 s).

**Correctness:** `check_logprobs_close` against HF and against the no-offload vLLM run, 8 prompts, greedy, for `google/gemma-4-E2B-it` and `google/gemma-4-E4B-it`: pass (token ids identical 8/8).

**Tests:**
- New `test_per_layer_embedding_offloading` (UVA and non-UVA) and `test_per_layer_embedding_with_prefetch_offloading` in `tests/basic_correctness/cpu_offload/test_cpu_offload.py`. The PLE test fails on `main` (table not offloaded) and passes here; the prefetch test passes on `main` and here, and fails without the guard (`wrap_modules should only be called once`). They use `google/gemma-4-E2B-it` with `load_format="dummy"`. CI runs this file on an 18 GB H200 MIG slice; all three new tests also pass on a 4090 at `gpu_memory_utilization=0.35` (~8.2 GiB, i.e. 0.5 of that slice), with 1.5-2.6 GiB left for KV cache.
- `pytest tests/basic_correctness/cpu_offload/test_cpu_offload.py`: 11 passed.
- `pytest tests/models/test_initialization.py -k Gemma4`: passed.
- `pre-commit run`: passed.

## Details

**Root cause.** The offloader only sees modules passed to `wrap_modules`, which for Gemma 4 happens via `make_layers` for decoder layers. The PLE table is a `VocabParallelEmbedding` built directly in `Gemma4Model.__init__`, so name filters never match it and byte budgets never reach it.

**Change.** Right after building the table, pass it through `get_offloader().wrap_modules(...)`, the same mechanism the vision/audio tower offload uses (`interfaces.py`). The table is a gather (one row per token), so reading it over UVA is cheap, unlike dense decoder weights.

**Guard.** Only done when `offloader.supports_tower_offload` is true (UVA). `PrefetchOffloader` allows a single `wrap_modules` call per model and would assert; prefetching the whole table every step would also be wasteful. With the prefetch backend the table stays on GPU as before. I reused `supports_tower_offload` since it already means "accepts extra `wrap_modules` calls"; happy to rename it if a more general name is preferred.

**Usage.** Recommended: `--cpu-offload-gb 5 --cpu-offload-params embed_tokens_per_layer` (E2B) / `--cpu-offload-gb 6 --cpu-offload-params embed_tokens_per_layer` (E4B). The budget is checked per parameter before offloading, so the table (a single parameter) is offloaded whole even with a smaller budget; passing at least the table size keeps the number meaningful.

**Limitations.**
- Non-UVA fallback (`VLLM_WEIGHT_OFFLOADING_DISABLE_UVA=1`, or no pinned memory, e.g. WSL) copies the whole table to the GPU on every forward. Correct but slow; same behavior as any module offloaded in that mode.
- No prefetch-backend support for the table (see Guard).
- Gemma 3n has the same per-layer table and the same problem; left for a follow-up.

---

@@ -141,3 +141,98 @@ def test_tower_weight_offloading(vllm_runner, monkeypatch, disable_uva):
     finally:
         set_offloader(original_offloader)
         envs.disable_envs_cache()
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("disable_uva", [False, True])
+def test_per_layer_embedding_offloading(vllm_runner, monkeypatch, disable_uva):
+    """`cpu_offload_params` segments must reach Gemma 4's per-layer embeddings.
+
+    Regression test: the PLE table is built outside `make_layers`, so it never
+    reached the offloader and `embed_tokens_per_layer` silently matched nothing.
+    """
+    monkeypatch.setenv("VLLM_ENABLE_V1_MULTIPROCESSING", "0")
+    if disable_uva:
+        monkeypatch.setenv("VLLM_WEIGHT_OFFLOADING_DISABLE_UVA", "1")
+    envs.disable_envs_cache()
+    original_offloader = get_offloader()
+
+    try:
+        with vllm_runner(
+            "google/gemma-4-E2B-it",
+            load_format="dummy",
+            enforce_eager=True,
+            gpu_memory_utilization=0.5,
+            max_model_len=128,
+            max_num_seqs=1,
+            enable_prefix_caching=False,
+            cpu_offload_gb=6,
+            cpu_offload_params={"embed_tokens_per_layer"},
+        ) as vllm_model:
+            engine_core = vllm_model.llm.llm_engine.engine_core.engine_core
+            model_runner = engine_core.model_executor.driver_worker.worker.model_runner
+
+            offloader = get_offloader()
+            assert isinstance(offloader, UVAOffloader)
+            assert offloader.cpu_offload_bytes > 0
+
+            model = model_runner.get_model()
+            ple = [
+                (name, module)
+                for name, module in model.named_modules()
+                if name.endswith("embed_tokens_per_layer")
+            ]
+            assert len(ple) == 1
+            _, ple_module = ple[0]
+            assert all(_is_offloaded(p) for p in ple_module.parameters())
+            if disable_uva:
+                # non-UVA fallback: weights live on CPU and are moved
+                # back on first forward
+                assert "forward" in vars(ple_module)
+
+            # Everything else must stay resident.
+            assert not any(
+                _is_offloaded(p)
+                for name, p in model.named_parameters()
+                if "embed_tokens_per_layer" not in name
+            )
+    finally:
+        set_offloader(original_offloader)
+        envs.disable_envs_cache()
+
+
+def test_per_layer_embedding_with_prefetch_offloading(vllm_runner, monkeypatch):
+    """The prefetch offloader allows a single `wrap_modules` call per model, so
+    Gemma 4's per-layer embeddings must not be routed through it."""
+    monkeypatch.setenv("VLLM_ENABLE_V1_MULTIPROCESSING", "0")
+    envs.disable_envs_cache()
+    original_offloader = get_offloader()
+
+    try:
+        with vllm_runner(
+            "google/gemma-4-E2B-it",
+            load_format="dummy",
+            enforce_eager=True,
+            gpu_memory_utilization=0.5,
+            max_model_len=128,
+            max_num_seqs=1,
+            enable_prefix_caching=False,
+            offload_group_size=1,
+            offload_num_in_group=1,
+            offload_prefetch_step=1,
+        ) as vllm_model:
+            engine_core = vllm_model.llm.llm_engine.engine_core.engine_core
+            model_runner = engine_core.model_executor.driver_worker.worker.model_runner
+
+            offloader = get_offloader()
+            assert isinstance(offloader, PrefetchOffloader)
+            assert offloader.total_offloaded_bytes > 0
+
+            model = model_runner.get_model()
+            assert not any(
+                _is_offloaded(p)
+                for name, p in model.named_parameters()
+                if "embed_tokens_per_layer" in name
+            )
+    finally:
+        set_offloader(original_offloader)
+        envs.disable_envs_cache()

+            # The PLE table is built directly, so `make_layers` never routes it
